notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.42 wheel; GPT-6.1 Sol (medium reasoning) through GitHub Copilot. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. Three infrastructure failures (a sandbox error, two connection errors) were rerun as replacements; the originals are kept as evidence.

Safety refusals: 10 trials ended with AgentSafetyRefusalError (model-extraction-relu-logits ×3, vulnerable-secret ×4, break-filter-js-from-html ×3) and score 0, except one break-filter-js-from-html trial whose verifier still passed: it counts as a pass here; bench-run's stricter rule counts it 0 (363/445).
Eleven trials hit fast-agent's 150 s stream-idle timeout on a model call and recovered on retry; none failed from it.

Cost is Harbor's recorded cost at the cohort's configured OpenAI list rates (card-packs pricing catalog 2026-09-29.1, rules gpt-6.1-sol-standard-short / -long: $2 / $0.10 / $10 per million input / cached / output tokens; $4 / $0.20 / $15 above 272k context). The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed. Stalled attempts recorded no usage, so the total is a lower bound. Prompt-cache writes are priced at the input rate, as for OpenAI models there is no cache-write charge.
